method: Web search (Tavily) of Fastmarkets, MMTA (Fastmarkets reprints), Argus, Benchmark, USGS MCS 2026, S&P/Platts, CSIS, Reuters, SMM-citing pages; key figures confirmed with tavily_extract where possible. One primary series per mineral (role=primary); other agencies/grades kept as role=secondary or role=exchina, never merged. value = midpoint of the published low-high range (range kept in 'range'); monthly averages dated YYYY-MM. No interpolation: quarters without a cited primary figure are listed in quarters_without_primary_point. index: per quarter, the latest-dated primary point in that quarter, divided by the first available primary point x100 (base quarter in index_base). precision=approx where the source says 'around/near/toward' or the figure is secondhand. Dates for 'Monday/Friday' references were resolved from article context; tweet date decoded from its ID. Game events compared from site/data.js EVENTS priceMult values.

antimony.notes: No cited 2023Q2 Rotterdam figure (USGS 2023 avg $5.60/lb Jan-Nov only), so index base = 2023Q3. Reality surged BEFORE the policy events: +70% Apr-Jun 2024 (Myanmar/China raw-material squeeze) with no event in the model. Sep-2024 controls x1.5 (assumed): Jul avg 22,461 -> Oct avg 32,433 = x1.44, close. Dec-2024 ban x1.40: Oct avg -> ~39,750 Dec = x1.23, but the rally continued to ~$58-59k by Apr-Jul 2025 (x1.45 more) -- model under-shoots the 2025 H1 peak. Nov-2025 truce x0.85: timing and size wrong -- decline began after the 4 Jul 2025 record, USGS/Argus was already $20.30/lb (~$44.8k/t) in Nov 2025, and Fastmarkets Rotterdam was $18-19k by Aug-Oct 2026 (-69% from peak), driven by new SE Asian smelters and demand destruction. Strategic Metals Invest's ~$51,800 (Jun 2026) conflicts with Fastmarkets and SMM ($11.80/lb = ~$26k/t); kept as a flagged secondary point. Gaps: 2023Q2, 2025Q1 (no FM point), 2025Q4/2026Q1/2026Q2 (FM).

Quota Oct-2025 x1.6 (assumed): ~$15.5 (Aug 2025) -> $24.3 (15 Dec 2025) = x1.57, correct. 2026Q2 quota ease x0.975: no cited 2026Q2 Fastmarkets point; level was $25.65-26.65 (Mar 2026) and the CME/Voltaire update put the standard-grade mid at $22.93 (16 Oct 2026) and $22.15 (23 Oct 2026), i.e. a mild drift down, consistent in sign. Reality also has a 2023-24 slide (-25%, oversupply from CMOC) before the DRC ban that the model doesn't need but should start from (index ~75 by late 2024). A Fastmarkets correction quoting $23.75-27.15 for a 'September 2' was excluded because its year is not stated on the page. Hydroxide (Fastmarkets cif China) moved far more: $5.65-5.75 (21 Feb 2025) -> $19.50-20.20 (Oct 2025), +245%. Gaps: 2023Q4, 2024Q2, 2026Q2, 2026Q3.
